title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a second made-up business to the Session 1 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app only shows a lemonade stall; students ask what break-even looks like for another small business.

## Context
Seeing the same idea in a second setting helps beginners see what is general.

## Expected outcome
A preset or a drawing mode for another made-up business (for example a bicycle repair stand) with its own sensible numbers.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The numbers are clearly marked as made up
- [ ] No NaN or off-canvas drawing at the slider limits

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use red and green for loss and profit; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or pattern (for example hatching) that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`, `sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Loss and profit distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: correlated price and demand
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. In Session 3 price, cost and demand are independent, but real customers buy less when prices are higher.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: seasons and a loan
body:
## Problem
Session 3 treats cash as the same every month and ignores borrowing.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3; the openloan repo explains monthly instalments.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app with a 12 month demand pattern and a loan, reporting the running total month by month.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: lines, histogram and tornado that move together
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows three linked pictures reacting to the price and the fixed cost; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Lines, histogram and tornado all respond to the same sliders
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
